channel.title: The Drill Down: Miami Dolphins
channel.description: Weekly NFL matchup scouting reports and win probabilities.

item.title: Week 12: Jets at Dolphins
item.description: Sun 11/29 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: NYJ -3.5 · O/U 40.5 | Model MIA 40% vs. market 35% | The game turns on whether Miami can keep its quarterback clean, since the Dolphins allow pressure on 24% of dropbacks while the Jets generate it on 22%. Garrett Wilson commands 25% of the Jets' targets against a Miami pass defense ranked 24th, so he should see the volume that matters most. Our model puts the Jets at 60%, a bit under the market's 65%, and the starting quarterback edge, with Geno Smith in the Jets' favor, is the largest driver of that lean.

item.title: Week 11: Dolphins at Bills
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: BUF -16.5 · O/U 45.5 | Model BUF 84% vs. market 90% | Miami must keep Buffalo's explosive plays from piling up, because the Dolphins allow them on 9.4% of snaps while the Bills generate them more often than any team in the league. Khalil Shakir creates 4.4 yards of separation, second-best in the league, and Miami's pass defense ranks 22nd to slow him down. Our model puts Buffalo at 84%, below the market's 90%, and the rushing matchup adds the most points toward the Bills.

item.title: Week 10: Dolphins at Colts
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: IND -4.5 · O/U 37.5 | Model IND 58% vs. market 66% | Indianapolis has to lean on the run, because Miami's defense ranks 31st against designed runs and allows -0.07 EPA per carry. Daniel Jones, who averages -1.30 EPA per dropback under pressure, must survive a Miami pass rush that ranks 14th. Our model has Indianapolis at 58%, well under the market, and the rushing matchup, worth 3.5 points, drives most of that gap.
